# Form Items: Get all Form Items

Area overview and notes: [form-items.md](../form-items.md)

`GET /users/{userId}/form-items` · tenant-scoped token

Get all form items within a tax year for a user.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `userId` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `continuation_key` | string | No | continuation_key from previous response (only needed for 1099_B) |
| `document_type` | string | Yes | The document for which the form items are retrieved. One of: `5498`, `1099_B`, `1099_INT`, `1099_DIV`, `1099_MISC`, `1099_NEC`, `1099_K`, `1099_DA`, `1099_R`, `1042_S`. |
| `tax_year` | string (four digit year) | Yes | Tax year to retrieve form-items from. |

**Response 200**: Form item with the provided ID.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form_items` | array of object | No | An array of this user's form items. If no document_type is provided, this returns all form items. |
| `form_items[].id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the form item. |
| `form_items[].user_id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) |
| `continuation_key` | string | No | Continuation key to get the next page of transactions. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
